title: Relay Task Definition
description: Task definition accepted by `relay create-task`. Kept in step with the runtime validator in relay/schemas.py (tests/test_packaging_schema.py fails if they diverge).

protocol_version.description: Relay task protocol version. Optional; defaults to 0.1.

repository.description: Absolute path to the repository. Must not be a production system.

base_ref.description: The ref that existed before this task. Used by the verifier as a baseline.

working_ref.description: Recorded for reference only; Relay checks out base_ref in the workspace.

objective.description: Plain-language description of what should be achieved.

requirements.description: Specific requirements the implementation must satisfy.

acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria reported as PASS, FAIL or UNVERIFIED. Only recognised test-suite criteria are checked automatically; any other criterion is UNVERIFIED and requires explicit human acknowledgement before COMPLETED.

requested_actions.description: Capabilities this task requests. Relay policy is the authority — tasks cannot grant themselves additional capabilities.

forbidden_actions.description: Actions the task itself explicitly forbids (in addition to Relay's global policy).

required_tests.description: Test files or patterns that Relay's verifier must run independently.

expected_deleted_tests.description: Baseline test node IDs the task is authorised to delete. Only honoured for tests actually collected in Relay's baseline.

expected_new_files.description: Workspace-relative paths the worker is expected to create. Any other new file fails verification. Cannot authorise protected additions (conftest.py, pytest configuration, start-up hooks).

approval_policy.description: auto = READY after policy validation; manual = BLOCKED until `relay approve-task`.
